fresh_retrieval_result: Official ORGI catalogue metadata remained independently discoverable and verified, but direct catalogue opening/download resolution returned an HTTP 502 during this cycle, so workbook bytes and exact Munda/Mundari rows were not obtained.

No Census mother-tongue label is treated as equivalent to community, ethnicity, identity, consent or cultural validation.
Catalogue download filenames are verified metadata, not proof that workbook bytes were acquired or reviewed.
A transient retrieval blocker does not mark this source complete; work continues on independent streams.
next_safe_action: Retry official workbook acquisition; if obtained, preserve workbook checksum, sheet name, exact row/cell coordinates and raw label before any evidence promotion.
